authorship: No product or test authorship; no patch applied, build, test, or browser run.

verdict_a_live.reason: The proposed patch is held outside the checkout after resource preflight refused the green run. Source review cannot establish installed-extension behavior, extracted row contents, recipe save/reopen/replay, or D42 lifecycle behavior.
verdict_a_live.required_proof: After integration, independently use the installed extension on the real event calendar: from Doctor's detected card list add title and URL, extract and inspect multiple distinct event rows, save, reopen and replay; separately start a fresh nested click and choose the intended scope, then cancel/restart while checking stale-session rejection.

confirmed: The patch does seed Pick more fields: ListPatternTab passes the current root and item selector to startListPickerSession; the session bridge passes JSON-serializable seed ?? null into mountListPicker (patch lines 25-34, 63-85). The restored checkout's unseeded caller is not evidence against this patch.

A valid seeded scope enters field selection without emitting a new detection event; result merging retains old fields only when both root and item selector match. A changed scope clears fields at detection (patch lines 5-24, 139-163, 194-219).

A fresh click now enumerates nested and outer repeated ancestors and waits for an explicit scope button when there are multiple matches; only scope selection emits detection. Field clicks can come from any matching item (patch lines 180-240, 255-300, 339-370).

D42's per-tab start/cancel sequence, target-session cancel check, producer session IDs, and ListPatternTab tab/session/page filters are not removed by this patch. This is source compatibility, not a regression result.

findings.finding: The patch changes the user-visible List Pattern flow but contains no update to the required feature test recipe. Add a concrete seeded Pick more fields and fresh nested-scope recipe with expected distinct row values before committing.

The page-change case unmounts the seeded picker and mounts a new picker without a seed. It proves clean remount, not the new invalid-seed fallback. Add a case passing a now-missing seed to mountListPicker and assert the warning, fresh scope choice, and correct new-page extraction.

The strengthened component test connects the entry button, session start, page producer, stamped consumer, merge, and extraction through simulated Chrome messaging. Its DOM and SW relay are still doubles; it cannot substitute for the required installed-extension check, and this review did not run it.

verdict_b_source.evidence: Read the complete preserved patch and surrounding source; git apply --check passed on the clean restored checkout. No execution evidence is claimed.
